dimensions.note: Two credential kinds added and neither carries a value: accessTokenFile and systemKeyFile are paths read at call time, like keyJsonFile; the token and the signed system assertion live in memory for the run, the assertion cached for its hour under apiUrl|systemUser. Nothing new is logged or stored: the only new sensitive field, PasskeyRegistration.code, is marked and emitted once. Seven credentials-sensitive-field warnings are accepted in place with the reason beside each: a path to a token, an OAuth scope string, five policy durations read from the login settings. The system type's role is wide by Zitadel's design (SYSTEM_OWNER is the only role with system.domain.write); the type offers four domain methods and no other, which is the scoping the code can give.

Every method logs its intent at info with structured placeholders ({domain}, {instance}, {username}) and its outcome; domainRemove logs the removal at warning as user delete does; a no-op says so at info. No path, token or key material reaches a log line or a property.

Every write follows a successful API call; a refusal (wrong confirm, generated or primary domain, absent domain, two instances, no credential, an empty token file, a key file that cannot be read) throws before any call or write, with the operation and the name in the message. API errors carry method, path, status and Zitadel's message; 429 and 503 retry with backoff as before. credentialKind centralises the one-credential rule so the policy check and the transport cannot disagree.

117 unit tests, 12 new: credentialKind for every kind and both refusals, systemAssertionClaims, getToken from a bearer file including the empty-file refusal, a System API assertion signed with a generated RSA key and cached, the passkey link in both deliveries and its machine-user refusal, and the four domain methods with the fake caller covering idempotent add, every domainRemove refusal, dryRun, the tombstone and the primary no-op. Live on 2026-11-06 against Zitadel v4.15.3 in podman with a SystemAPIUsers key mounted: domainList, domainAdd twice, domainSetPrimary there and back, the confirm refusal, dryRun, domainRemove and the list after, all as the unit tests say; and user list through accessTokenFile with a token the service key had minted. The smoke batches a to p were not rerun: no existing method's path, body or lifecycle changed, only the credential plumbing, which the live run exercised.

domainAdd returns the live domain unchanged when it is there; domainSetPrimary is a no-op on the primary; domainRemove is verify-first and refuses a domain that is not there rather than succeeding silently, which is this package's convention for every delete (confirm repeats the live name) and is stated in the description. A run interrupted between the API call and the write leaves Zitadel changed and no record, which the next domainList repairs.

System API v1 paths and bodies read from proto/zitadel/system.proto of v4.15.3 and confirmed live: instances/_search, instances/{id}/domains/_search, instances/{id}/domains, DELETE instances/{id}/domains/{domain}, instances/{id}/domains/_set_primary; the passkey link from user_service.proto with sendLink.urlTemplate. Both searches send an explicit query limit of 1000, above any instance's domain count, and fields are read through str, optStr and === true, never assumed. The audience of the system assertion is baseUrl(apiUrl) without a trailing slash, which is what the server builds from ExternalDomain, ExternalPort and ExternalSecure, and the README says so.
Files are read whole with Deno.readTextFile; fetches carry the per-request timeout; nothing is created outside Zitadel. The instance id and every domain are stored as resources a later run can read.

README and manifest describe the eighth type and the three credential kinds with example.org names and placeholder paths; test fixtures use example.org and example.test; no real host, address or id appears. The .review report is committed with the release as before.

InstanceDomain, InstanceInfo and PasskeyRegistration are plain z.object with no passthrough; the two booleans are required, the optional fields are the ones the API may omit (name, state, codeId, code).
instance-domain and passkey-registration carry lifetime infinite with garbageCollection 10 and 5, instance 5, matching the package's sibling specs.

The system type is list, add, remove and set-primary, which is the whole of what the System API offers for a domain; there is no update. A generated domain cannot be removed by anyone (Zitadel refuses with GeneratedNotRemovable) and the method refuses it first with a plain message; the README says so.

Every type keeps credential-named (policy) and reachable (live); the system type's own pair checks that the credential is a system key with its user and that the System API lists an instance for it. Mutating methods are guarded by the checks' labels for selective skipping as before.

instance-domain-<domain>, instance-<id> and passkey-registration-<username>, all through instanceName's sanitiser, no collision across methods: every method writing instance-domain writes the same shape, and domainRemove tombstones the name before writing its removed record, as user delete does.
No method reads stored state back; each reads the live list from Zitadel and compares. No dataRepository access.

All seven existing types move to 2026.11.02.1 with an upgrade entry naming the new optional argument and that nothing existing changed; the system type is new at 2026.11.02.1 with no upgrades. The manifest is 2026.11.02.1.
